title: Alex Krainer: Bond Market Collapse & the New Chinese Economic Order
summary:
Alex Krainer is a market analyst, author & former hedge fund manager. Krainer argues that the crisis in the bond market will spread across the financial system and create great incentives to use military power to acquire new colonial possessions to rescue the situation. However, the financialised economic model will break down, and the entire economic model will be discredited.
